title: Mobile-friendly Layouts
seo: Mobile-friendly dashboard layouts for tablet and phone
meta: Make your dashboard comfortable on tablets and phones, with tables, charts and menus that adapt. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Dashboards that work on tablets and phones
overview: If your dashboard only works on a big monitor, you lose people who check it on the move. We rework the layout so menus collapse neatly, cards stack, charts resize and tables stay readable on small screens. We test on real phone and tablet sizes, make buttons large enough to tap, and keep the desktop view as it is, so nothing is lost for your existing users.

Which devices do you test on?
Common phone and tablet sizes in current Chrome and Safari, using real device sizes in testing tools. Tell us if your customers use a particular device and we include it.
